summary:

Nearest resistance is SMA50 at 172.84 (+1.47%), then the 20-session high 178.36 (+4.71%) and SMA200 at 181.18 (+6.37%) [E:pxs:AAPL:2024-04-30:levels]. Bollinger %B at 0.562 is mid-band, leaving room in both directions [E:tsnap:AAPL:2024-04-30:levels].
Timing and entry: Do not chase; the stock is below its SMA50 and SMA200 and just gave back 1.83% on the last session, so wait for a pullback toward the 169.62 SMA20 / 164.08 support zone before considering a long [E:pxs:AAPL:2024-04-30:levels][E:tsnap:AAPL:2024-04-30:momentum]. A decisive reclaim of SMA50 172.84 would be the alternative trigger, but the primary trend argues for patience [E:pxs:AAPL:2024-04-30:ma].
Invalidation: A close below the 20/63-session low 164.08 (-3.67% from the last close) would break the base and invalidate any long-side view [E:pxs:AAPL:2024-04-30:stops][E:pxs:AAPL:2024-04-30:levels].
risks: A close below the 20/63-session low 164.08 (-3.67%) would break support and extend the downtrend [E:pxs:AAPL:2024-04-30:levels].
Elevated own-history volatility (vol_21d 24.06%, 85th percentile; ATR 2.00% of price) raises the odds of stop-outs on normal noise [E:tsnap:AAPL:2024-04-30:volatility].

SMA50 at 172.84 (+1.47%) and SMA200 at 181.18 (+6.37%) cap rallies and could reject price [E:pxs:AAPL:2024-04-30:levels].
